title: Transformation of Phaeodactylum tricornutum by electroporation
author: Gina Filloramo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.s4cegsw
materials: Chill a 0.2 cm electroporation cuvette on ice.
Colonies should start appearring after about 12-14 days.

steps.title: Prepare linearized plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Digest approximately 6 µg of pPha-T1/eGFP with ScaI for 2.5 hours and purify the linearized plasmid using a Macherey-Nagel Nucleo-Spin gel and PCR clean-up kit.

steps.title: Prepare P. tricornutum cells
steps.instruction: Grow P. tricornutum cells to a density of 5 × 10^6 cells/ml.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Harvest and wash cells to prepare them for electroporation.

substeps.instruction: Harvest 2 × 10^8 cells by centrifuging at 1500 g for 10 min at 4°C and remove the medium.
Wash cells three times with 1 ml of sterile, ice-cold 375 mM sorbitol, spinning between washes at 1500 g for 1-2 mins at 4°C if needed.
Before the third wash, transfer cells to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.
Perform the final sorbitol wash and resuspend cells in 100 μl of 375 mM sorbitol to a final density of 2 × 10^9 cells/ml.

steps.title: Prepare electroporation mixture
steps.instruction: Combine the resuspended cells with DNA and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Mix the 100 μl aliquot of resuspended cells with 4 μg (0.2 μg/μl) of linearized plasmid DNA and 40 μg (10 μg/μl) of denatured salmon sperm DNA.
Incubate the mixture on ice for 10 min.
Transfer the mixture to a 0.2 cm electroporation cuvette.

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells using an exponential decay setting with specific parameters.

steps.title: Post-electroporation recovery and selection
steps.instruction: Recover cells and plate them for antibiotic selection.

substeps.instruction: Immediately transfer cells after electroporation to 15-ml conical Falcon tubes containing 10 ml f/2 medium.
Incubate in low light (~ 30 μmol photons m^−2 s^−1) for 24 hours.
Incubate under normal culturing conditions for an additional 24 hours.
Collect cells by centrifuging at 1500 g for 10 min and resuspend in 0.6 ml f/2 medium.
Plate serial dilutions onto solid medium containing 75 μg/ml zeocin.
